# Onuri: Notes & Life Tracker

> Onuri is a clean, private-first iOS application designed to help users track their daily notes, habits, and life milestones effortlessly.

## Core Links
- App Store: [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796028277)
- Landing Page: [Onuri Website](https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-notes-life-tracker/)
- Privacy Policy: [Privacy Policy](https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/privacy.html)
- Terms of Service: [Terms of Service](https://jhr1986.github.io/onuri-legal/terms.html)

## Overview
Onuri provides an intuitive mobile interface for personal journaling, note-taking, and life tracking without compromising user privacy. Built natively for iOS.
